notes.title: 2025 Season 4 Patch 1 [2025.09.12.01]
notes.notes:
[p]This Patch contains some updates and fixes for the 2025 Season 4 Release.[/p][p]You can find the Release Notes for this Patch below, or on the iRacing Forums here:[/p][p][url="https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/85557/2025-season-4-patch-1-release-notes-2025-09-12-01"]https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/85557/2025-season-4-patch-1-release-notes-2025-09-12-01[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Simulation[/b][/h2][h3][b]User Interface[/b][/h3][list][*][p]GENERAL:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some values had excessive decimal precision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where spin controls were lacking feedback when selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stutter when race flags are shown for the first time.[/p][/*][*][p]Added VR screen space controls to the Options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a FOV calculator bug that mixed up imperial/metric units, causing the FOV to come out wrong.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]SESSION SCREEN:[/p][list][*][p]Added a gradient behind the steering wheel in the Session Screen to improve contrast.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where multiple items in the top bar of the Session Screen were not center-aligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the driver select dropdown would not update when new drivers entered the session.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the radar not keeping a square aspect ratio.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]DRIVE SCREEN:[/p][list][*][p]In the F1 box, moved the real-time clock from the header space to the bottom row, and added a Sim-time clock alongside it.[/p][/*][*][p]The F2 and F3 boxes have been adjusted to no longer require a scrollbar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the positioning of black box controls after moving them and then transitioning to another screen, or closing the Sim.[/p][/*][*][p]Larger size options have been added for Virtual Mirror and the Delta Bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where all black boxes would grow larger when a car had a large car-specific black box.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with some elements clipping with a narrower top bar and the focus driver element.[/p][/*][*][p]The tire change feedback icon is now hidden when not in a Race Session.[/p][/*][*][p]UI layer settings for a few widgets have been adjusted to ensure layering priority for: Pit Speed, Pit Info, Pacing, Flags, and Penalties.[/p][/*][*][p]To help make the drive screen UI and text larger and more readable, we adjusted the Drive Screen to allow UI scaling past where the Session Screen will stop applying it.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the spacing between the driver names and the AI helmets in the Results and Entries tabs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]GARAGE SCREEN:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the garage canvas could overlap the bottom bar.[/p][/*][*][p]The Tech Inspection spinner is now appropriately centered.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]OPTIONS SCREEN:[/p][list][*][p]Dropdowns that have many options now correctly show a scroll bar at all times.[/p][/*][*][p]Options Screen scaling within split layouts have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tooltips for the Controls section of the Options screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the label for the Shift Aid option.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some extra borders from items in the Controller Configuration Wizard screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sound cards could disappear from the Options screen if they had a unicode character in their name.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]BROADCAST MODE:[/p][list][*][p]Added the split mode/broadcast UI.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Dirt Racing[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Raised the collision and damage thresholds for Dirt Road cars making contact with the environment. This allows for a bit more aggressive driving before receiving an incident from a wall or bump collision.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Graphics[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where driver names that display on vehicles would incorrectly appear as uppercase, or not appear at all, when reloading the car paint via the CTRL+R command.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some audio level and mixing issues with the updated hybrid systems for all applicable cars.[/p][/*][*][p]Hybrid motor audio has been tuned.[/p][/*][*][p]A setting has been added to the “app.ini” file that allows users to display sound levels in dB units or a generic slider.[/p][list][*][p]'soundUiControlsInDb=1' displays the level sliders in dB.[/p][/*][*][p]'soundUiControlsInDb=0'  displays the level sliders in a range from 0-100.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Controls[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved the auto-detection of Fanatec wheels.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Cars[/b][/h2][h3][b]<Car Class> GTP Class Cars[/b][/h3][list][*][p]For GTPs that feature the hybrid system, fixed an issue with the deployment cutting unexpectedly after a few laps.[/p][/*][*][p]For the new hybrid system, added an atmospheric condition correction to the allowable halfshaft power.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]<Car Class> Touring Class Cars (TCR)[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Acura NSX GT3 EVO 22[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the rainlight would not properly disfigure with rear-end damage.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Audi 90 GTO[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Audi R18[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Onboard engine sounds have been improved.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BMW M Hybrid V8[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated the rev limiter type to be consistent with other GTP cars in the class.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BMW M4 GT3[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Dallara F3[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Dirt Big Block Modified[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Strengthened the rear spoiler.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Dirt UMP Modified[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Ford GT GT2[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Ford Mustang GT3[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash that was occurring with the iRacing lemans_fixed setup.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Ford Mustang GT4[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the pit limiter to now be available in all gears.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the decrement bind on the TC2 setting.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Kia Optima[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Dirt Late Model[/b][/h3][list][*][p](ALL) - iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Mercedes-AMG W12 E Performance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Battery SoC value was not displaying correctly in the In-Car Adjustments black box.[/p][/*][*][p]For the new hybrid system, added an independent setting that overrides the selected deploy mode. This can be activated in fixed setups.[/p][/*][*][p]For the new hybrid system, improved attack mode to be more aggressive with deployment but with greater battery drawdown. This improves its use as an overtaking tool but will hurt SoC management overall.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the maximum-achievable turbo boost to improve engine performance at high altitude tracks.[/p][/*][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Mercedes-AMG W13 E Performance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Battery SoC value was not displaying correctly in the In-Car Adjustments black box.[/p][/*][*][p]For the new hybrid system, added an independent setting for recharge mode that overrides the selected deploy mode. This can be activated in fixed setups.[/p][/*][*][p]For the new hybrid system, improved attack mode to be more aggressive with deployment but with greater battery drawdown. This improves its use as an overtaking tool but will hurt SoC management overall.[/p][/*][*][p]Added further adjustments to engine braking to improve braking stability.[/p][/*][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NASCAR Gen 4 Chevrolet Monte Carlo - 2003[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Gauge lightmap has been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 Clubsport MR[/b][/h3][list][*][p]TS and ESC switches are now mappable to the TC1 and TC2 in-car controls respectively.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Skip Barber Formula 2000[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Toyota GR86[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.
[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Tracks[/b][/h2][h3][b]Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez (Mexico City)[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an ad on the right-side wall near the start of the pit entry lane.[/p][/*][*][p]The slowdown penalty at Turn 2 has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]A variety of config-specific fencing has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Distant buildings textures have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p](Oval) - Moved the restart zone cones into the grass.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bristol Motor Speedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Chicago Street Course[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Darlington Raceway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Daytona International Speedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p](Road Course) - Moved the anti-cut pyramid curbs in the LeMans chicane closer to the sawtooth curbs.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Dover Motor Speedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Homestead Miami Speedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Iowa Speedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Kansas Speedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Las Vegas Motor Speedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Lucas Oil Indianapolis Raceway Park[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Martinsville Speedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]New Hampshire Motor Speedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Oulton Park Circuit[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the visual popping distances on some tire bundles.[/p][/*][*][p]Flagstand numbers have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Terrain texture has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]pit wall textures have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Rockingham Speedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Sonoma Raceway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]All missing UI images have been added.[/p][/*][*][p](Indycar 2012-2018) - Adjusted the cones and walls around the hairpin.[/p][/*][*][p]A variety of visual and physical touch-ups have been completed at this track, including:[/p][list][*][p]A variety of floating objects have been tethered appropriately.[/p][/*][*][p]Objects around the drag strip are now solid.[/p][/*][*][p]Outer fences have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Weekend crowds around the mini golf course area have been touched-up.[/p][/*][*][p]Parasol and umbrella placements have been optimized for perfect picnicking.[/p][/*][*][p]The tunnel area has been updated.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Talladega Superspeedway[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some terrain seams have been patched.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Watkins Glen International[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Levitating track marshals have been grounded. They do not need to practice that behavior at work.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 2025 Season 4 Release
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h2][b]2025 Season 4 Release Notes \[2025.09.09.01][/b][/h2][p]--------------------------------------------------------------

[/p][p]The iRacing 2025 Season 4 Release Build has passed tech inspection and is ready to roll! This release introduces new content, features, improvements, and fixes for 2025 Season 4, which officially starts on September 16th at 0000 UTC!
[/p][p]“#soon” has arrived, and the new Sim UI is finally here! Rebuilt from the ground up, the new Sim UI utilizes modern technology, tools, and design principles to power an advanced new UI framework and in-sim experience. The new Sim UI should appear familiar in form to long-time users, with select new capabilities and functionality. This powerful new technology paves the way for significant future innovation and all-new sim experiences and features.[/p][p][/p][p]The iRacing vehicle garage expands with three new bays for three brand-new cars: the Aston Martin Vantage GT3 EVO, the Dallara IL-15 (INDY NXT), and the Ford Mustang GT4! The entire GT4 Class of cars has received a multifaceted performance, tires, and physics overhaul. The hybrid system for vehicles has been updated for improved realism. The drafting parameters for the NASCAR Gen4 cars have undergone extensive adjustments to optimize the racing experience. And the BMW M4 GT3 has been updated to the EVO spec with new physics and art.
[/p][p]The iRacing world map adds the legendary track, Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, direct from Mexico City. Sonoma Raceway, World Wide Technology Raceway, Charlotte Motor Speedway, and North Wilkesboro Speedway have each been re-scanned and remodeled. Six additional tracks have been overhauled with all-new artwork, including five on the NASCAR schedule and Oulton Park Circuit.
[/p][p]¡Saluda a España! iRacing introduces localization for many parts of the iRacing application. Customers may now select to use iRacing in European Spanish. We are still working on translation technology for some areas of the iRacing application, the Sim itself, and additional languages will also be coming in the near future.
[/p][p]All three new cars come fully equipped and ready for rain racing (Aston Martin Vantage GT3 EVO, Dallara IL-15, Ford Mustang GT4)! AI Drivers are ready for competition with FIVE new cars (Aston Martin Vantage GT3 EVO, Dallara IL-15, Ford Mustang GT4, and the NASCAR Gen4 Class Cars)! And, AI Drivers have already mastered North Wilkesboro Speedway - Oval and all seven track configurations for the brand new Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez (Mexico City)![/p][p]
[/p][p]Season highlights include:[/p][list][*][p]New Sim UI[/p][/*][*][p]Aston Martin Vantage GT3 EVO[/p][/*][*][p]Dallara IL-15 (INDY NXT)[/p][/*][*][p]Ford Mustang GT4[/p][/*][*][p]Physics Overhaul for the GT4 Class, including Rain Tires updates[/p][/*][*][p]BMW M4 GT3 updated to EVO spec[/p][/*][*][p]Hybrid System Overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Substantial NASCAR Gen4 Drafting Updates[/p][/*][*][p]Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez (Mexico City)[/p][/*][*][p]Rescanned and remodeled tracks: Charlotte Motor Speedway,  North Wilkesboro Speedway, Sonoma Raceway, and World Wide Technology Raceway.[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled and modernized tracks: Chicago Street Course, Circuit of the Americas, Daytona International Speedway, Texas Motor Speedway, Watkins Glen International, and Oulton Park Circuit[/p][/*][*][p]Texture Compression Update[/p][/*][*][p]VR Headset Eye-Tracking Foveated Rendering Support[/p][/*][*][p]European Spanish for much of the non-in-Sim iRacing application[/p][/*][*][p]All three new cars come ready for rain racing! (Aston Martin Vantage GT3 EVO, Dallara IL-15, Ford Mustang GT4)[/p][/*][*][p]AI Racing is now available with FOUR new cars! (Aston Martin Vantage GT3 EVO, Ford Mustang GT4, and the NASCAR Gen4 Class Cars)[/p][/*][*][p]AI Racing is now available at North Wilkesboro Speedway, Circuit of the Americas - NASCAR West, and all SEVEN track configurations for the brand new Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez (Mexico City)! AI Drivers have also been retrained from scratch at Charlotte Motor Speedway - all EIGHT non-Dirt configs, Sonoma Raceway - all NINE non-Dirt configs, and World Wide Technology Raceway (Gateway) - Oval.[/p][/*][*][p]Hundreds of meticulously engineered new vehicle setups[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p][p]Visit our 2025 Season 4 features page here: [/p][p][url="https://www.iracing.com/seasons/2025-s4/"]https://www.iracing.com/seasons/2025-s4/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]

[/p][p]Full 2025 Season 4 Release details are below.[/p][p]

[/p][h2][b]iRACING:[/b][/h2][p]--------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Localization[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Customers may now select to use iRacing in European Spanish![/p][list][*][p]This translates much of the non-in-Sim iRacing application. For more information about what this includes, does not include, and if you are a native speaker, how you can help us improve our work here:[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/84408/european-spanish-localization-feedback#latest"]https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/84408/european-spanish-localization-feedback#latest[/url][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]AI Racing[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Randomly generated AI Opponent Rosters have been further improved with more than 300 new color combinations, specialization by car and class type, and the addition of new sponsors.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Flags[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The country of Netherlands Antilles has been removed from the selectable list. This country was dissolved in 2010.[/p][/*][*][p]The country of Swaziland has been appropriately renamed to Eswatini.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Paint Kit[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tons of new sponsors have been added to the Paint Kit, including:[/p][list][*][p]iRacing Downshift, iRacing Studios, Advance Auto Parts, Advent Health, Alcon, Ally, Anduril, Ansys, BBS, Big Fish BBQ, Borla, Callies, Castrol, Cometic, Cosworth, CW Sports, Dart, Fifth Third, Five Star Bodies, FOD Control, Horizon Hobby, HTL Technologies, Hyperco, Intercomp, Jack Links, JBL, JE Pistons, Jostens, JRi Shocks, Klotz Synthetics, Kooks, Liquid Death, Loose is Fast Podcast, Losi RC Cars, Mack Trucks, Quarter Master, Racing Electronics, Safety Kleen, Schluter Systems, SKF, SPxE, SRI, Stratasys, Technique Chassis, Trak Racer, and UNOH.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Some sponsors have been updated in the Paint Kit, including:[/p][list][*][p]Build Submarines (secondary color added)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]3rd Party /data API & /jforum Use[/b][/h3][list][*][p]If you are currently consuming the /data API or interacting with the legacy /jforum endpoint, please see this post for changes coming in the December 2025 Release (2026 Season 1).[/p][list][*][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/84226/legacy-authentication-removal-dec-9-2025/p1?new=1"]https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/84226/legacy-authentication-removal-dec-9-2025/p1?new=1[/url][/p][p]

[/p][h2][b]SIMULATION:[/b][/h2][p]--------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]User Interface[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The new Sim UI is here![/p][/*][*][p]The new Sim UI is a complete re-architecture and rebuild of the in-Sim user interface, built from the ground up on powerful modern technology and an all-new framework. [/p][/*][*][p]The initial experience has been crafted to function in a familiar way, with a fresh new look made possible by its modern rendering capabilities, along with multiple advancements in functionality and features, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]Black Boxes:[/b] These now have minimized and expanded states. The Relative and Standings boxes display additional data.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sim Options redesign:[/b] Options have had a significant reorganization, including the merging of the Replay and Driving graphics options. We’ve also added a clickable table of contents down the left-hand side, and to the right, we’ve added more information to explain the setting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alt-K to move UI:[/b] When pressing Alt-K to move elements around, you’ll find an additional toggle control to enable/disable all moveable elements, so now it’s easier to visualise those elements which normally only display when activated (such as flags and penalty notices).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Virtual Mirror size control:[/b] Via Alt-K, you can now also select the size of your virtual mirror from a drop-down menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Real-world clock:[/b] You now have access to your local wall-clock time via the F1 menu and also via an optional dedicated widget. This widget can be toggled in the Settings under the Interface tab in the On-Screen Displays section (Real Time Clock).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Tool redesign:[/b] The Camera Tool is now accessible via a dedicated button found on the Session screen, and the tool itself is now more logically presented following a design update. The Ctrl-F12 binding is still available to toggle the Camera Tool.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tooltips:[/b] The vast majority of controls now display tooltips when you mouse over them.[/p][/*][*][p]UI scale and opacity can now be adjusted while editing the layout or in Settings under the Interface tab in the Scaling & Opacity section.[/p][/*][*][p]All widgets can be made visible through a simple checkbox, and if you decide you don't like your changes, a convenient reset button is available. We've also made the UI editing mode easier to find, with some buttons to help you get started configuring.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We are very excited about the future of the new Sim UI, and we want feedback about your experience, including what new features you want to see and how it should evolve. Additionally, if you experience any problems, we’d like to hear from you as well. To facilitate this, we have created a new Forum for providing feedback for the in-Sim UI, and encourage you to share your thoughts:[/p][list][*][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.iracing.com/categories/sim-ui"]https://forums.iracing.com/categories/sim-ui[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Physics[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The hybrid system for all of our hybrid car types has been overhauled for this release. This is an improvement for how we develop our vehicle power unit code. For more details on exactly what this means for each type of vehicle, please see this post from our Vehicle Development Manager:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/84630/hybrid-system-update-goals-scope-and-what-it-means-for-you#latest"]https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/84630/hybrid-system-update-goals-scope-and-what-it-means-for-you#latest[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Race Control[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The hold delay for cars starting a race from pit lane has been increased by 3 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]The pace car pit exit speeds and timing for picking up the field have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]The pace car will now pull out of the pits a little bit earlier for cautions where the leader was early in the lap.[/p][/*][*][p]The "!remove ..." chat command is intended to remove only a single person from the event. [/p][list][*][p]You may now use "!remove #N" with N being the full car number, provided that car only has a single declared driver. In that situation, that team’s one-and-only driver will be removed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Dynamic Track Model[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved the simulated weather and time effects on the track before the first session begins to more accurately set the stage for the event.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some paved off-track surface temperatures could be significantly different from paved track surface temperatures.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]AI Racing[/b][/h3][list][*][p]AI Drivers are now ready to drive the following new vehicles:[/p][list][*][p]Aston Martin Vantage GT3 EVO[/p][/*][*][p]Ford Mustang GT4[/p][/*][*][p]NASCAR Gen 4 Chevrolet Monte Carlo - 2003[/p][/*][*][p]NASCAR Gen 4 Ford Taurus - 2003[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]AI Drivers are now ready to race at the following new locations:[/p][list][*][p]Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez (Mexico City) - all SEVEN configs[/p][/*][*][p]Charlotte Motor Speedway - EIGHT non-Dirt configs (fully re-trained)[/p][/*][*][p]Circuit of the Americas - NASCAR West[/p][/*][*][p]North Wilkesboro Speedway - Oval[/p][/*][*][p]Sonoma Raceway - NINE non-Dirt configs (fully re-trained)[/p][/*][*][p]World Wide Technology Raceway (Gateway) - Also unique to the venue is the Foro Sol section, which sends drivers through baseball stadium seating; this same area of the track has also been used for the 2019 Race of Champions. [/p][p]This Patch Release contains updates and fixes for the 2025 Season 3 Release.[/p][p]

[/p][h2][b]iRACING:[/b][/h2][p]--------------------------------------------------------------[/p][h3][b]Flags[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Race Results would display a customer's previously selected Flag instead of the Flag they had selected at the time of the event.[/p][list][*][p]Results preserve the flag participants were flying at the time of event entry as historic data.[/p][/*][*][p]This was especially noticeable for customers attempting to use our recently added flags for the countries of the United Kingdom: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, and Wales.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]SIMULATION:[/b][/h2][p]--------------------------------------------------------------[/p][h3][b]Licenses & Official Racing[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the distribution of iRating and ttRating values that define Division separation for all Official Racing and License Classes for improved competition at all levels.[/p][list][*][p]We had tuned the division distribution slightly with the start of 2025 Season 3, and we missed the mark by a bit. This second adjustment should clean things up and improve Ranked participation.[/p][/*][*][p]With the deployment of this Patch, all members will be redistributed into Divisions for all licenses classes, just as is done seasonally before Week 1. This redistribution will be completed based on drivers’ iRating, ttRating, and Rookie status as they were a few weeks ago when divisions were first established during the 2025 Season 3 season transition. Drivers are not being redistributed based on their current iRating, ttRating and Rookie status. All previous 2025 Season 3 records, stats, and results will follow their owners into their new Division.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Graphics[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some damp to wet tracks could have blocky patterns appear at dusk.[/p][/*][/list][p]

The ramping reference location has also been adjusted.[/p][list][*][p]At 100% pedal input, the brake bias is equal to the basic brake bias setting.[/p][/*][*][p]At 0% pedal input, the brake bias is equal to the basic brake bias setting plus the brake migration gain.[/p][/*][*][p]Please note, to adjust existing setups the recommendation is to halve the current brake migration setting and increase brake bias forwards by 1-1.25%.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]<Car Class> NASCAR Gen 4 Series[/b][/h3][list][*][p]iRacing setups have been updated.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Acura ARX-06 GTP[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Brake Migration adjustment has been added to this car to bring it into line with the other GTP class cars.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Dallara IR18[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the incorrect car model could appear in UI images related to short oval tracks.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Ferrari 499P[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Updated the brake migration tooltips for improved clarity.[/p][list][*][p]Note, brake migration was already working correctly in this car and thus no physics changes have been applied nor is it necessary to adjust setups for this car.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]\[Legacy] V8 Supercar Ford FG Falcon - 2014[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Restored the rear view mirror to its proper place. notes.title: 2025 Season 3 Release [2025.06.10.01]
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h2][b]2025 Season 3 Release Notes \[2025.06.10.01][/b][/h2][p]
[/p][p]The iRacing 2025 Season 3 Release Build has passed tech inspection and is ready to roll! This release has new content, features, improvements, and fixes for 2025 Season 3, which officially starts on June 17th at 0000 UTC! The iRacing vehicle garage expands with three new bays for three brand new cars: Ferrari 296 Challenge, and a pair of NASCAR Gen 4 cars straight from 2003, the Chevrolet Monte Carlo and the Ford Taurus! The entire GT3 Class Cars has received a multifaceted performance, tires, and physics overhaul, as well as dramatic performance updates for the NASCAR Cup Series Gen 7 Class Cars, and the Dallara IR18. The iRacing overworld map adds one additional massive track, Shell V-Power Motorsport Park at The Bend, near Adelaide, Australia. The Track Art Team has also completed multiple full art overhauls of TWELVE NASCAR circuit tracks including: EchoPark Speedway (Atlanta), Indianapolis Motor Speedway, Iowa Speedway, Lime Rock Park, Lucas Oil Indianapolis Raceway Park, Martinsville Speedway, Michigan International Speedway, Nashville Superspeedway, Phoenix Raceway, Pocono Raceway, Richmond Raceway, and Talladega Superspeedway.[/p][p][/p][p]iRacing is proud to add direct paint kit support for vehicles with multiple body types, including the Dallara IR18 and the new NASCAR Gen 4 stockcars. Adaptive AI has been expanded and is now available for use in Hosted Racing Sessions, as well as AI Seasons. 9 completely new AI Seasons have also been added including IMSA, NASCAR, Production Car Challenge, and more! This update also fully sunsets Clubs and introduces the Flags feature - select and wear your colors proudly! Support for a new VR technology, Fixed Foveated Rendering, has been added for Open XR which can improve rendering speed. A host of updates and tuning improvements have been added to the Connectivity Black Flag System, thanks to the data we have been collecting. We have also added support for 360 Hz Force Feedback for several more devices![/p][p][/p][p]This update also unlocks rain racing for FIVE formula cars, including: Dallara IR18, Lotus 79, Skip Barber Formula 2000, and both Super Formula SF23 - Honda & Toyota! AI Drivers have expanded their racing skills and may now pilot four new cars, including: Audi R18, Ferrari 296 Challenge, Porsche 919, and Silver Crown. AI Drivers have also trained for racing at eleven new track configs, including: Daytona International Speedway - Moto - 2008 & Short - 2008, Iowa Speedway - Oval, Richmond Raceway, and all seven configs at Shell V-Power Motorsport Park at The Bend.[/p][p][/p][p]Season highlights include:[/p][list][*][p]Ferrari 296 Challenge[/p][/*][*][p]NASCAR Gen 4 Chevrolet Monte Carlo - 2003[/p][/*][*][p]NASCAR Gen 4 Ford Taurus - 2003[/p][/*][*][p]Physics Overhauls for GT3 Class Cars, NASCAR Cup Series Gen 7, and Dallara IR18[/p][/*][*][p]Shell V-Power Motorsport Park at The Bend[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]TWELVE NASCAR Track Art Overhauls (EchoPark Speedway (Atlanta), Indianapolis Motor Speedway, Iowa Speedway, Lime Rock Park, Lucas Oil Indianapolis Raceway Park, Martinsville Speedway, Michigan International Speedway, Nashville Superspeedway, Phoenix Raceway, Pocono Raceway, Richmond Raceway, Talladega Superspeedway)[/p][/*][*][p]Car Body Support has been added to the Paint Kit[/p][/*][*][p]Adaptive AI Racing for Hosted Sessions[/p][/*][*][p]Adaptive AI Racing for AI Seasons[/p][/*][*][p]Brand new Pre-Made AI Seasons[/p][/*][*][p]Flags now fully replace Clubs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Foveated Rendering for Open XR[/p][/*][*][p]360 Hz Force Feedback for more devices[/p][/*][*][p]Connectivity Black Flag System Updates[/p][/*][*][p]High CPU Usage Warning[/p][/*][*][p]FIVE additional cars are Rain-Ready! (Dallara IR18, Lotus 79, Skip Barber Formula 2000, Super Formula SF23 - Honda, and Super Formula SF23 - Toyota)[/p][/*][*][p]AI Racing is now available with FOUR new cars! (Audi R18, Ferrari 296 Challenge, Porsche 919, and Silver Crown)[/p][/*][*][p]AI Racing is now available at ELEVEN new track configurations! (Daytona International Speedway - Moto - 2008 & Short - 2008, Iowa Speedway - Oval, Richmond Raceway, and Shell V-Power Motorsport Park at The Bend - ALL SEVEN CONFIGS)[/p][/*][*][p]Hundreds of caringly crafted new vehicle setups[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]Visit our 2025 Season 3 features page here: [/p][p][url="https://www.iracing.com/seasons/2025-s3/"]https://www.iracing.com/seasons/2025-s3/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]Full 2025 Season 3 Release details can be found on the iRacing Forums here:[/p][p][url="https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/80339/2025-season-3-release-notes-2025-06-10-01"]https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/80339/2025-season-3-release-notes-2025-06-10-01[/url][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 2025 Season 2 Patch 3 Release
notes.notes:
[h1]2025 Season 2 Patch 3 Release Notes [2024.04.02.02][/h1]

[list]
[*] This Patch Release contains updates and fixes for the 2025 Season 2 Release.
[*] This Patch Release also includes the new feature, Adaptive AI Racing for Single AI Sessions!
[/list]


[b]Simulation[/b]

AI Racing
[list]
[*] Adaptive AI is now available for Single AI Sessions!
[*] - - Adaptive AI is an all new system that provides each iRacer an AI Racing experience that's tuned to their individual preferences and desired level of challenge. Rather than tuning difficulty percentages, with Adaptive AI users choose whether they are looking for a Low, Medium, or High level of challenge. This experience is dynamic and tuned to each iRacer, so one racer's Low might be another racer's Medium. While Adaptive AI is built for iRacers of all abilities, it does have a sweet spot and it's possible that some of our fastest racers might exceed the pace that the system can provide. As with all iRacing systems, Adaptive AI will continue to evolve and improve as we collect and incorporate iRacer feedback.
[*] - - Adaptive AI will make its debut in Single Race, with a follow-up planned for Hosted iRacing and AI Seasons at a later date.
[*] AI Drivers have improved their racing lines at USA International Speedway.
[*] AI Drivers have improved their racing skills with the NASCAR Truck Series Class Trucks.
[/list]

Physics
[list]
[*] The physics processing for collisions involving opponent vehicles has been updated for improved accuracy.
[*] - - Opponent cars now automatically update their physics processing frequency to a much higher rate any time they detect they are in close proximity to any object, or whenever a collision occurs.
[*] - - - - This alleviates an issue where opponent vehicles could sometimes appear to snag on walls, climb up objects, or trigger other visual oddities.
[*] - - Torque scaling applied during impacts to wheels has also been adjusted. Opponent vehicles now behave much more realistically when striking walls with their wheels.
[/list]

Dynamic Track Model
[list]
[*] Updated the appearance of dynamic track debris within the space tangential to the track surface.
[*] Fixed an issue with normal mapping of track debris, making their visible bumpiness more correct.
[/list]

Graphics
[list]
[*] Lighting exposure intensity for when the sun is within 15 degrees of the horizon has been reduced.
[*] Improved the brightness of pit entry/exit lights and caution lights, especially at sunset.
[*] Improved brightness in foggy, rainy, and overcast conditions.
[*] The lighting gradient at the horizon line has been improved.
[*] Improved the appearance of fog over terrain surfaces and in mirrors.
[*] Improved MSAA processing for foggy conditions.
[/list]

Spotter/Crew Chief

notes.title: 2025 Season 2
notes.notes:
[h1]2025 Season 2 Release [2024.03.10.03]
[/h1]
The iRacing 2025 Season 2 Release Build has rolled up to the starting line! This release has new content, features, improvements, and fixes for 2025 Season 2, which officially starts on March 18th at 0000 UTC! The iRacing vehicle garage expands with three new bays for three brand new ARCA Series racecars: ARCA Chevrolet SS, ARCA Ford Mustang, and ARCA Toyota Camry. The Legends Ford '34 Coupe has received a stem-to-stern performance and physics overhaul, with a few art updates and all-new audio for good measure. The iRacing landscape also grows with the addition of Portland International Raceway. The Track Art Team has also completed multiple full art overhauls of SEVEN classic NASCAR tracks including: Bristol Motor Speedway, Darlington Raceway, Dover Motor Speedway, Homestead Miami Speedway, Iowa Speedway, Kansas Speedway, and Las Vegas Motor Speedway.

We are excited to launch the Official Series Redesign, which transforms the way you can browse, learn about, and join Official Series within iRacing - the new full-page layout provides more space and more info than ever before. A new Connectivity Black Flag system has been implemented, which will place participants with connections that are detrimental to others in a type of time-out until their connection quality reaches a satisfactory level. The track debris refresh system has been expanded with the addition of informative local course debris caution flags. The new Adaptive AI Difficulty system is almost ready to debut with this initial release, but we have decided it needs a bit more time in the oven to get extra crispy. With this system, AI Drivers' racing skill will automatically adjust during the event based on the driver's lap times to keep the racing exciting. This feature will be released during a 2025 Season 2 Patch.

Our vehicle engineers have completed work on updates to the GTP Class Cars and the LMP2 tires, providing substantial improvements to the changes from 2025 Season 1, ultimately resulting in greater realism. The Ray FF1600 has received an improved suspension geometry model, which improves accuracy across all four contact points and will be the pioneer for changes to other vehicles to come. Six additional tracks have been updated with the 3D modeled curb system (with more coming soon), making the racing experiences there more real-to-life than ever. The entire iRacing Simulator has also received significant lighting updates that transform the appearance of cars and tracks.

The Legends Ford '34 Coupe has been updated to be water-ready and may now equip rain tires. The updates to this car have been so substantial this season that the Legends Ford '34 Coupe - Rookie car is being retired. AI Drivers have received updates for a variety of rain racing tracks and have adapted to the updated NASCAR tracks that now feature SAFER barriers. The Dallara iR-01 and seven new track configs, including Portland International Raceway, are AI-racing ready. Finally, our vehicle dynamics team has recalibrated hundreds of vehicle setups to take advantage of the gamut of changes to all cars included in this release. Get ready to jump into all that the 2025 Season 2 has to offer!


[b]Season highlights include:
[/b][list]
[*] ARCA Chevrolet SS
[*] ARCA Ford Mustang
[*] ARCA Toyota Camry
[*] Legends Ford '34 Coupe vehicle overhaul
[*] Portland International Raceway
[*] SEVEN NASCAR Track Art Overhauls (Bristol Motor Speedway, Darlington Raceway, Dover Motor Speedway, Homestead Miami Speedway, Iowa Speedway, Kansas Speedway, and Las Vegas Motor Speedway)
[*] SIX Tracks with New 3D Curbs (Circuito de Jerez - Ángel Nieto, Kansas Speedway, MotorLand Aragón, Rudskogen Motorsenter, Sandown International Motor Raceway, and Winton Motor Raceway, with more coming soon.)
[*] Official Series Redesign
[*] Connection Black Flag
[*] Local Course Debris Cautions
[*] Universal Lighting Updates
[*] GTP and LMP2 Tire Updates
[*] Ray FF1600 4-Bar-Linkage Suspension Model
[*] The Legends Ford '34 Coupe is Rain-Ready!
[*] AI Racing with the Dallara iR-01
[*] AI Racing at Portland International Raceway (both configs), Daytona International Speedway - NASCAR Road Course, Moto, & Short, and Mid-Ohio Sports Car Course - Chicane & Short
[*] Hundreds of meticulously improved new iRacing vehicle setups
[/list]


Visit our 2025 Season 2 features page here: https://www.iracing.com/seasons/2025-s2/


Full 2025 Season 2 Release Notes can be found on the iRacing Forums here:
https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/75906/2025-season-2-release-notes-2024-03-10-03#latest

[h1]2025 Season 1 Vehicle Telemetry Update [2025.02.18.01][/h1]

This is a Vehicle Telemetry Update, containing a new anonymized race data telemetry collection system.


[h2]iRacing[/h2]

[h3]Anonymized Telemetry Data:[/h3]
[list]
[*] iRacing has implemented an additional, anonymized telemetry system that we will be using to power future improvements and features for the iRacing Simulation.
[*] - This additional telemetry system is separate and distinct from the current telemetry used by Atlas, Motec and other 3rd party applications. No changes are required for 3rd parties using the existing telemetry system as it is not changing.
[*] Race data telemetry is generated automatically while drivers are participating in select Official Series. Series with vehicle data telemetry collection enabled will be identified. After a driver exits the Session, the telemetry data they generated will be automatically, and securely, collected by iRacing.
[*] Members may opt-out of participating in the vehicle telemetry data collection process if they wish, and telemetry data is only collected from participants with the user preference enabled who participate in specific Official Series, which will be identified.
[*] - Members may opt-out by selecting to do so on the Settings > Preferences page.
[*] This system will be enabled in select Official Series, beginning with a new Week 11 Series: iTested Series
[*] - We encourage participation and entrants will be awarded the seldom-offered “iTested!” Award for participating!
[/list]

This is a Patch Release, containing updates, improvements, and fixes for the 2025 Season 1 Release.


[h2]Simulation
[/h2]
Anti-Cheat
- The antiquated versions of EasyAntiCheat (Kamu EAC) files have been renamed and relocated in the iRacing file structure to prevent confusion with the currently active and in use Epic Game EasyAntiCheat (EOS) version of Anti-Cheat software.
- Some additional steps have been taken to remove the previous generation of the AntiCheat system used by iRacing (Kamu/EAC).
- - The iRacing Updater will now ask you if you want to uninstall the old Kamu/EAC derivation of EasyAntiCheat, if you happen to still have it installed and it is associated with iRacing (Game 36). If when prompted you choose "No", it won't ask again in the future. Also note that the old Kamu/EAC installer, and our .bat script that uses it, have been moved to a subdirectory, to distinguish it as being "old" and obsolete.

Race Servers
- Made a change to how the scheduler creates Open Practice Sessions.

Race Control
- Fixed an issue where a Lucky Dog driver could be incorrectly forced to give up spots to lapped cars after a delayed green. We now make sure the EOL penalty isn't applied again when entering the "Two to Green" state a second time.
- Consecutive single file restarts is now a value that may be overridden by the admin "!restart" command.
- - The number of laps gap between cautions used by consecutive single file restarts is now admin overridable with: !csf N
- - The default value is 2 laps gap. Acceptable range is 1-10 laps. Setting to 0 will revert to whatever the default setting for the session is (2).
- - Consecutive single file restart behavior will not happen during green-white-checkered laps (GWC), the normal restart type will be used instead.

AI Racing
- AI Drivers have improved their ability to recover from crashes or going off-course during parade laps.

Graphics
- The mip map tossing algorithm has been updated.
- Fixed a compatibility issue with some OpenXR runtime states.
- Fixed an issue for users with 9th and 10th generation Intel CPUs running on Windows 10 who are receiving random Simulator crashes.


[h2]Cars

- For the damage model, reduced friction on plank hulls to reduce grounding and snagging.

[/b]
This is a Patch Release, containing updates, improvements, and fixes for the 2025 Season 1 Release.


[b]Simulation
[/b]
Anti-Cheat

Weather

Dynamic Track Model
- For the debris system, adjusted the parameters for vehicle bodies picking up debris, including better accounting for smaller body shapes, pickups being scaled by speed, and implementing a maximum amount of debris for vehicle bodies depending on chassis size.
- For the debris system, improved the ability for debris to adhere and shed from vehicle bodies.
- For the debris system, the algorithms for flinging debris have been updated.
- For the debris system, improved the calculations for generating gravel dust by tires.
- For the debris system, normalized the color for gravel dust to improve its overall tone in all environments.

Dirt Racing
- For Dirt Oval Racing, apron areas should now be a bit rougher to drive on.

AI Racing
- Fixed an issue where AI Vehicles could lose the ability to support MGUK-only driving if the host leaves the Session.

Audio
- Support has been added to XAudio to allow single channel audio hardware, including many Bluetooth headsets.
- The number of sounds that can be loaded by the Simulation has been increased. This provides greater support for third-party sound packs.
- Fixed an issue where the volume selected via the user interface was not being saved to the "app.ini" file.

Pit Lane
- Auto Fuel will not enable itself if a pitstop is in progress. This fixes an issue where it was briefly enabling itself and modifying fuel fill values during driver swaps in team racing.

Spotter/Crew Chief

- - Account Information: View and update details like your subscription status, billing address, and customer ID.
- - Account Balance: Monitor your iRacing Dollars and Credits, toggle the use of credits in sync with your cart, and check when your credits expire. Additional features here include: Send a Gift or Add Funds, Buy a Gift Card, Refer a Friend, and Check a Promo Code.
- - Account History: The Account History section provides a detailed overview of your past transactions and activities, offering a transparent and organized way to review your iRacing orders and gift transactions. Features include: the ability to display a list of purchases, gifts received, and gifts sent.  Each transaction is listed in a row for quick and easy understanding of the data.  A View Order button allows you to drill down into the specifics of any transaction.



[b]Simulation[/b]

Dynamic Track Model
- Improved the calculations for track debris accumulated and thrown by opponent vehicles.
- Improved the throwing and spreading algorithm, especially for gravel, for a more realistic and uniform distribution.
- Fixed a critical issue where some developer code for the Debris Refresh remained available for adjustments by drivers.
- Fixed an issue where the new debris type, gravel and mud, were not being cleared correctly between Sessions if the option for cleaning the track between Sessions was enabled for an event.

Weather
- Values for rain on track surfaces have been smoothed, so puddles are more visible.

AI Racing
- Fixed an issue where some AI Drivers in Formula cars believed themselves to be indestructible and unaffected by damage sustained - they would simply not pit for repairs and just keep racing even when heavily damaged. It may benefit some Members to take note of this corrected behavior.
- Fixed an issue where AI Drivers did not understand Fast Repairs and would refuse to pit to fix damage whenever Fast Repairs were available. They now understand these are good, and should use them when needed.

Graphics
- Fixed an issue where Anti-Aliasing settings were incorrect after upgrading from an older "renderer.ini" file.


[b]Cars[/b]

<Car Class> NASCAR Cup Series Gen 7
- iRacing setups have been updated.

<Car Class> NASCAR Xfinity Series
- iRacing setups have been updated.

<Car Class> Supercars - Gen 3
- Fixed an issue where the pit crews were unable to correctly switch your Tire Compound during a pit stop. They now appropriately know which compound is which! The tire compound dashboard indicator light now also functions perfectly.

Acura NSX GT3 EVO 22
- Fixed an issue where the rear rainlight was not appearing correctly on undamaged cars.

BMW M8 GTE
- Lightmaps have been updated to fix an issue where the digital display appeared to be “off” all the time.

Ferrari 499P
- Side damper deflections have been added to the Chassis tab of the Garage - it was possible to adjust the heave elements in a way that pushed side damper deflections out of range. 
- ID lights have been changed to white.
- Fixed an issue where the MGU value did not match the MGU dial.
- Fixed an issue with the deploy mode rotary knob being misaligned.
- Fixed an issue with the strategy rotary knob label.

Legends Ford '34 Coupe
- iRacing setups have been updated.

Porsche 963 GTP
- iRacing setups have been updated.

Supercars Ford Mustang Gen 3
- The Ford logo on the nose has been updated.

[Legacy] NASCAR Cup Chevrolet Impala COT - 2009
- Fixed an issue where all dashboard gauges were blank white.


[b]Tracks[/b]

Circuit Zolder
- Track marshals, photographers, cameramen and safety vehicles have been deployed.

Huset's Speedway
- Barney, Legendary Flagman, has arrived at this track!
- Treeline textures have been updated.
- Tree placement has been improved.

Mid-Ohio Sports Car Course
- Some cones have been added to brake markers.

New Hampshire Motor Speedway
- Added pit exit aid lines to Road configs, and blue lines and cones added to the configs that use the infield in Turn 1.
- Trackside banners have been updated.
- Tree placement and colors have been improved.
- Some unintended wall openings have been blockaded.
- Fixed an issue where a tire barrier was protruding onto the track in Turn 3.
- Fixed an issue where stretched marbles textures could appear on some track walls.

notes.title: 2025 Season 1 Release
notes.notes:
[h1]2025 Season 1 Release Notes [2024.12.09.03]
[/h1]

The iRacing 2025 Season 1 Release Build has arrived! This release includes new content, features, improvements, and fixes for 2025 Season 1, which officially starts on December 17th at 0000 UTC! The iRacing garage expands with five new bays for: Acura NSX GT3 EVO 22, BMW M2 CSR, Ferrari 499P, Supercars Chevrolet Camaro Gen 3, and Supercars Ford Mustang Gen 3. The BMW M2 CSR is being released as new FREE content to all iRacing Members! iRacing is also excited to offer two new tracks: Huset's Speedway and Thruxton Circuit. The Track Art Team has also completed a full overhaul of the classic New Hampshire Motor Speedway, bringing its look and feel up to modern standards.

The Test Drive Service which is available whenever iRacing is down for maintenance has been re-built from the ground-up, is integrated seamlessly with the iRacing application, and is now known as Demo Drive! Our graphics and physics developers have tag-teamed an outstanding upgrade to the debris system which now includes mud and gravel, and all debris types are now easier to see and impact racing much more realistically. We are pioneering some upgrades to the iRacing netcode system with this Season Release, including improving the experience for a lagging driver as well as everyone else in the race with them. The lighting for the entire iRacing world has undergone an improvement which increases contrast and reduces some excessive brightness. Your spotter will now inform you if any damage you receive is going to have a negative impact on an aspect of your vehicle performance. AI drivers have also now been trained in the art of headlight flashing when passing.

Our hydromancers have prepared the Formula Vee for rain racing, and ALL FIVE new cars come equipped with a unique set of rain tires. AI Racing systems have been programmed and implemented on six cars, including: Acura NSX GT3 EVO 22, BMW M2 CSR, Ferrari 499P, Supercars Chevrolet Camaro Gen 3, Supercars Ford Mustang Gen 3, and Williams FW31. AI Drivers have mastered Thruxton Circuit and two of New Hampshire’s Road Courses. And last but not least our vehicle dynamics team has polished and included over 400 new and updated vehicle setups to give you the optimal driving experience using any car at any track. Prepare your racing rig for 2025 and get hyped for iRacing 2025 Season 1!


Season highlights include:
[list]
[*] Acura NSX GT3 EVO 22
[*] BMW M2 CSR [FREE!]
[*] Ferrari 499P
[*] Supercars Chevrolet Camaro Gen 3
[*] Supercars Ford Mustang Gen 3
[*] Huset's Speedway
[*] Thruxton Circuit
[*] New Hampshire Motor Speedway (2024 Art Upgrade)
[*] Demo Drive
[*] Debris Refresh
[*] Netcode Improvements
[*] Specular Lighting Upgrade
[*] Spotter Damage Effects Report
[*] AI Flashing Behavior
[*] Formula Vee and ALL FIVE new cars are all Rain-Ready
[*] SIX new cars for AI Racing (Acura NSX GT3 EVO 22, BMW M2 CSR, Ferrari 499P, Supercars Chevrolet Camaro Gen 3, Supercars Ford Mustang Gen 3, and Williams FW31)
[*] THREE new tracks and configs for AI Racing (Thruxton Circuit, New Hampshire Motor Speedway -Road Course & Road Course with North Oval)
[*] Over 400 happily crafted iRacing vehicle setups
[/list]


Visit our 2025 Season 1 features page here: [url=https://www.iracing.com/seasons/2025-s1/]https://www.iracing.com/seasons/2025-s1/[/url]


Full 2025 Season 1 Release details can be found on the iRacing Forums here:
[url=https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/71285/2025-season-1-release-notes-2024-12-09-03#latest]https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/71285/2025-season-1-release-notes-2024-12-09-03#latest[/url]

notes.title: 2024 Season 4 Patch 3 Release Notes [2024.10.09.01]
notes.notes:
[h1]2024 Season 4 Patch 3 Release Notes [2024.10.09.01]
[/h1]
This is a 2024 Season 4 Patch Release that contains some impactful updates and needed fixes for issues.


[b]iRACING:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
Account Management
iRacing now supports 2-factor authentication (2FA) using Time-based One-Time Passwords (TOTP).
This can be configured in the Security section of Account Management (https://oauth.iracing.com/accountmanagement/security/).
The Support articles below explain how to set this up for your account.

[list]
[*] How do I set up 2-factor authentication?
[*] https://support.iracing.com/support/solutions/articles/31000173750-how-do-i-set-up-2-factor-authentication
[*] How do I disable 2-factor authentication?
[*] https://support.iracing.com/support/solutions/articles/31000173893-how-do-i-disable-2-factor-authentication
[*] Enabling or Disabling Legacy Read Only Authentication
[*] https://support.iracing.com/support/solutions/articles/31000173894-enabling-or-disabling-legacy-read-only-authentication
[*] What do I do if I have lost my 2-factor Authentication device?
[*] https://support.iracing.com/support/solutions/articles/31000173895-what-do-i-do-if-i-have-lost-my-2-factor-authentication-device
[/list]

3rd Parties using /data API
If you are currently scraping the /data API, please see this post about how this affects you.
https://forums.iracing.com/discussion/comment/584862/#Comment_584862

iRacing Companion App
Only versions of the iRacing Companion App that support 2FA will be functional after today’s release (v1.9.3 or newer). If you get an authentication error in the Companion App, be sure to go to your app store and download the latest and greatest version of the iRacing Companion App to continue using it (v1.9.6).



[b]SIMULATION:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
Physics
For a variety of vehicle classes, fixed an issue where having a small amount of vehicle damage and encountering a minor ground snag could trigger an aerodynamics calculation cascade resulting in an unauthorized moon launch. The vehicles fixed with this aerodynamic update include:
- - All GT4 Class Cars
- - All TCR Class Cars
- - FIA F4
- - Toyota GR86

Race Control
Fixed an issue where a Race would fail to start if the entire field was starting from the pits.
- - This was just a communication issue between iRacing track officials, Barney, Legendary Flagman, and Fred, Flawless Wheelman.

Heat Racing
Fixed an issue that could crash RaceServers if no Heat Sessions were actually setup during a Heat Racing Event.

Graphics
The texture loading algorithm has been updated for improved processing.
Fixed a memory leak in the particle effects system.



[b]CARS:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
Dallara IR18
Fixed a competition issue where the amount of P2P available for use during an event could be reset if the driver’s internet connection was unstable.

Ford Mustang GT3
For the damage model, wheel mounts have been slightly strengthened.

Mini Stock
For the damage model, the allowable rear suspension hyperextension distance has been reduced.

Super Formula SF23
Fixed a competition issue where the amount of P2P available for use during an event could be reset if the driver’s internet connection was unstable.



[b]TRACKS:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
Cadwell Park Circuit
The off-track surface properties at the exit of the final two corners have been updated to behave more like grass than pavement.
Fixed an issue where some pit entry tire barriers were only partially solid objects.

Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
(2024 Configs) - The normal pace lap starting grid position has been moved to the straight after Pouhon.

Road America
Track surface bumpmap has been regenerated.
Signage and bridge textures have been updated.
Terrain colors have been updated to better match the grasses.

notes.title: 2024 Season 4 Patch 2 Hotfix 1 Release Notes [2024.09.25.03]
notes.notes:
[h1]2024 Season 4 Patch 2 Hotfix 1 Release Notes [2024.09.25.03]
[/h1]
This release is a Hotfix that contains important fixes and some additional updates for the 2024 Season 4 Patch 2 Release.


[b]SIMULATION:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
iRacing Weather System
For Forecasted Weather Mode, fixed an issue where cloud cover and rain predictions were being calculated incorrectly in the short term.
- - This fixes an issue where the Spotter would continually call out upcoming weather changes incorrectly. Please be advised that your Spotter is not a meteorologist - he’s just doing the best he can.

Heat Racing
Fixed an issue where the track surface temperature could spike an extra 45°F if a Session within a Heat Racing event was skipped. This is not what was meant by “heat” racing!

Graphics
Fixed an issue with rain-enabled car windshields where extremely dramatic and opaque sunspot shines or shadow flares could appear on the glass.
Fixed an issue where chrome and brushed wheels could appear black in interface images.
Fixed an issue where some cars appeared to have lost their windshield glass in the paint shop. 

Audio
Improved the sounds for rumble saw-tooth curbs.
Fixed an issue where many engine starter sounds would fail to play.

Telemetry
Some values for the Push-to-Pass system (P2P) have been added to telemetry.
- - P2P_Count = Displays the total number of seconds of P2P remaining.
- - P2P_Status = Displays if the P2P system is active.


[b]CARS:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
Lotus 49
The brake bias adjustment increment has been reduced from 0.5% to 0.25%.

McLaren 720S GT3 EVO
Aerodynamic drag has been increased slightly, clutch inertia has been increased, and engine inertia has been decreased to match information from McLaren.

NASCAR Cup Series Toyota Camry
For the damage model, fixed an issue with the attachment points for the front fenders.

NASCAR Cup Series Next Gen Ford Mustang
Adjusted the lighting properties on the metallic nose strip.

NASCAR Xfinity Ford Mustang
Adjusted the lighting properties on the metallic nose strip.


[b]TRACKS:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
Daytona International Speedway
(Road Course) - The slowdown penalty at the first left curb in the Bus Stop has been relaxed slightly. Drivers now need 2 tires in the grass at the center of the apex to trigger the slowdown penalty.

Hockenheimring Baden-Württemberg
For all configs that use the main pit lane, the safe entry rule has been tightened up. Cars now must clear the racing surface before the green painted area.

Watkins Glen International
Some missing water drains have been added.

notes.title: 2024 Season 3 Patch 2 Release
notes.notes:
2024 Season 3 Patch 2 is live and ready for racing!

========================================================================
[h1]2024 Season 3 Patch 2 Release Notes [2024.06.28.01]
[/h1]

This Patch Release contains a variety of updates and fixes for the 2024 Season 3 Release.
This Patch includes the release of the Oswego Speedway - Dirt track configuration!
This Patch also includes an update on the widely reported GPU crashing issues that started with the 2024 Season 2 Release.



[h2]iRACING:
[/h2]--------------------------------------------------------------
Web Data API
Results / Get
- - Added ‘strength_of_field’ and ‘num_entries’ to each car class in the event results for the class SoF and entry count.
- - Removed ‘simulated_start_utc_time’ and ‘simulated_start_utc_offset’ from results “weather” object, and added ‘simulated_start_time’ to be consistent with Weather objects in other areas of the API.
Series / Seasons
- - Removed duplicate ‘simulated_time_multiplier’ from schedule objects. Now only appears in the “weather” object in each schedule.
- - Removed ‘simulated_start_utc_time’ from the schedule “weather” objects.



[h2]SIMULATION:
[/h2]--------------------------------------------------------------
Race Servers
Improved validation for allowing or disallowing rolling starts based on the selected track for an event.

AI Racing
AI Drivers have improved their wet racing lines on a variety of tracks, especially for heavy rain.
Fixed an issue when AI Drivers would sometimes space out at Superspeedways, and forget to leave the pit or grid stall.
Fixed an issue with various Asphalt Oval cars that could cause the Simulation to crash when AI Drivers were using some final drive ratios at the iRacing Superspeedway.

iRacing Weather System
Updated the visual effects for rain running up a windshield. This stops droplets from disappearing before they physically leave the windshield.
Fixed an issue where rain effects could sometimes be visible when watching Replays when it's not raining at the current timestamp.
Improved how windshield wipers operate during Replays
Improved how wet and dry states for windshield wipers progress based on vehicle velocity and the wet/dry state of the Session.
Fixed an issue where aerospray could appear blocky when HDR was disabled.
Improved the wet/dry appearance of the windshield during Replays, particularly when rewinding or transitioning through wet/dry states.
Fixed an issue where windshield wipers were not clearing water correctly when manually activated while auto wipers were disabled.
Fixed an issue where the times used by visual effect calculations for windshields could become incorrect.

Cars
Fixed an issue where opponent cars could appear to have the incorrect wing angle settings based on what the driver had set.

Graphics
An update has been made that shows evidence of avoiding the widely reported GPU crashes that started with the 2024 Season 2 Release.
- - We have added a mechanism to disable SMP/MVP/SPS only for the particle effects system code (PopcornFX). Some evidence shows these processes interacting with PopcornFX systems may be triggering the GPU crashes reported shortly after the release of the iRacing Weather System.
- - With this Patch 2 Release, those special Nvidia-only modes (SMP/MVP/SPS) bypass the PopcornFX system. These modes are still fully enabled for all other rendering. This change should have a minimal impact on performance processing and framerate.
- - - - Should you wish to override this new default, you can find two new values in your appropriate “rendererDX11*.ini” file: “PopcornFXSPSAllowed” and “PopcornFXSMPMVPAllowed”. Setting both to “1” re-enables the special Nvidia-only modes for the particle effects system.
Fixed an issue where full-resolution particle effects were not appearing correctly in the top-left quadrant of the screen.

Replays
Fixed an issue where Replays could fail to load if they included a driver who registered but failed to join the Session.

Controls
Support for Conspit pedal vibration has been added.
The latest Simucube API has been integrated.
Fixed an issue where Force Feedback was not being properly enabled when the setting: “enable360HzInterpolated=0” for Simucube wheels.

Telemetry
The race server name is now logged in the Session string.



[h2]CARS:
[/h2]--------------------------------------------------------------
<Car Class> GT3 Class Cars
iRacing setups have been updated.
- - At Daytona International Speedway and Circuit des 24 Heures du Mans, the tallest available gear ratios are now specified. Nürburgring setups have been renamed so they load at combined (Nordschleife) layouts automatically.

<Car Class> LMP1 Class Cars
For the damage model, bent wheels can now be fully repaired.

<Car Class> NASCAR Cup Series Next Gen Class Cars
Tire parameters have been updated with quicker overall tire conditioning.
For the damage model, front tire sidewall friction has been reduced to improve wall collision behavior. This was especially noticeable when looking at opponent cars.

<Car Class> Rallycross Vehicles
For the damage model, slightly bent wheels are now allowed to be fully repaired when these vehicles are racing at non-Rallycross track configurations.
For the damage model, lateral break limits for wheels have been increased.

<Car Class> Stock Car Pro Series Class Cars
Fixed an issue where old Replays (using Old Damage Model) would not load with these cars.

<Car Class> Street Stocks
Fixed a visual issue where the driveshaft was slightly misaligned.
A damage model tuning update has been completed which further reduces engine damage transfer, and slightly stiffens the nose.

<Car Class> V8 Supercars Class Cars
A damage model tuning update has been completed which strengthened wheels and updated nose hulls for additional coverage of the front wheels.

Acura ARX-06 GTP
Balance of Power Adjustment: Downforce and engine power have been slightly reduced.

BMW M4 GT3
Fixed an issue where the interface model used the incorrect rear wing end-plates.

BMW M4 GT4
Rain lights have been updated.
Updated the appearance of undamaged rainlights.
Brake lights have been updated to punch-through aerospray better.
Textures for cockpit labels have been updated.
Backfire effects have been updated.
Fixed a visual issue with wheels at certain camera distances.
Fixed an issue where damaged car parts could appear on undamaged cars.

Dallara IR18
Steering weight has been reset to the pre-2024 Season 3 value.

Dallara P217
For the damage model, the nose may now be fully detached and its break limits and properties have been adjusted.

Dirt Micro Sprint Car
(Outlaws) - Fixed an issue where these model versions were unable to receive any pit service.
Improved some external engine sounds.

Ford Mustang FR500S
Fixed an issue with ambient occlusion in the interface model for this car.

Ford Mustang GT3
For the damage model, the nose is now stiffer when fully attached.
The iRacing fixed setup now has more rear camber.

Ligier JS P320
For the damage model, the nose may now be fully detached and its break limits and properties have been adjusted.

Modified - SK / NASCAR Whelen Tour Modified
(Modified - SK) - For the damage model, the front and rear bumper stiffnesses have been updated.

NASCAR Xfinity Ford Mustang
Paint patterns have been updated with black trim pieces to match the other NASCAR Xfinity cars.

Nissan GTP ZXT
A damage model tuning update has been completed which stiffens and raises the break limits for the nose, which should stop cones from destroying it.

Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 Clubsport MR
Fixed an issue where rainlights were not working at far camera distances.

Porsche 911 GT3 Cup (992)
iRacing setups for SIlverstone have been updated.

Porsche 911 GT3 R (992)
Updated the texture for pull tabs in the cockpit.

Radical SR8
Fixed an issue where headlights were not working correctly at night.

Ruf RT 12R
Fixed an issue where cockpit mirrors were extra dark.

Street Stock - Casino & Eagle
Fixed an issue where the number font slant direction was reversed.

[Legacy] NASCAR Truck Chevrolet Silverado - 2008
iRacing setups have been updated.



[h2]TRACKS:
[/h2]--------------------------------------------------------------
Circuito de Navarra
Fixed an issue where a phantom rogue pit stall was placed on the racing surface, which could cause race control and surface-type related issues with cars passing through the area.
Brake markers for the final turn have been corrected.
Improved issues with visual popping for a variety of objects as the camera changes distances from them.

Daytona International Speedway
(2008 Configs) - Fixed an issue where drivers could complete full laps by circling behind pit road.

Oswego Speedway
NEW TRACK CONFIGURATION - Oswego Speedway - Dirt!
- - A new Dirt Oval track configuration is now available at this track, Dirt!
Improvements have been made to skid marks, asphalt cracks, and track surface textures.
Fixed an issue where opponent cars could sometimes appear to snag an inside wall and appear to leap into the air.
Fixed an issue where some concrete barriers, outside walls, and infield fences were non-solid objects.
Crowd positioning has been updated.

Sachsenring
Some track textures have been updated.
Improved the visual display of the wind turbines.
Treelines have been updated.
Improved some ARMCO and track surface line textures.

WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca
Updated the track logo that was incorrect in a few places.

World Wide Technology Raceway (Gateway)
Updated the track logo that was incorrect in a few places.

notes.title: 2024 Season 3 Patch 1
notes.notes:
[h1]2024 Season 3 Patch 1 Release Notes [2024.06.07.01]
[/h1]
This Patch Release contains a variety of updates and fixes for the 2024 Season 1 Initial Release. This Patch includes Barney, additional damage model tuning for several cars, fixing a handful of critical stability issues, and ensuring our competition is fair and top-notch. Get ready for Week 1 racing, starting at midnight UTC tonight!


[b]iRACING:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
Profile - Awards
Fixed an issue where the Rovaler Awards could get out of sync.
The Award, “The Profiler” has been retired.


[b]SIMULATION:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
iRacing Weather System
The progression of the windshield condensation effect has been improved with aesthetic splotchiness.
Raindrop texture generation has been made faster.

Race Control
Fixed some issues with properly disallowing the Pace Car from participating in Rallycross events. Fred is not allowed on Rallycross tracks because of what happened back in 2017.

Engine
Drivetrain spring torques are now capped at realistic levels to prevent an unstable drivetrain from causing a Zippy event and exploding the Simulation physics.
- - When slipping the clutch in high gear, the numbers can get unstable and oscillate the drivetrain pretty badly. This change prevents the physics engine from crashing - instead you will just hear horrible noises and potentially damage your drivetrain.

Dirt Racing
The “Out of Control” incident threshold for facing a wrong direction has been loosened slightly.

Time Trial
The number of laps for valid Time Trial runs have been unified for Road and Dirt Road Racing as follows:
- - Track Configs Less than 2 miles = 8 Laps
- - Track Configs Greater than 2 miles = 5 Laps
- - Circuit des 24 Heures du Mans = 2 Laps
- - All Nürburgring Nordschleife (and Combined) Configs = 1 Lap

Graphics
Fixed an issue where some track surface sections could appear far too shiny.

Spotter
For Spotter text, some pronouns have been updated.

Spotter - Foreign Language
A few additional samples have been added to the Portuguese-Guto_Colvara pack.


[b]CARS:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
<Car Class> NASCAR Cup Series Next Gen Series Car
iRacing setups have been updated.

<Car Class> NASCAR Truck Series Trucks
For the damage model, side skirt damage is no longer repairable, and the right-side skirts are now less likely to get damage from lateral impacts.
iRacing setups have been updated.

<Car Class> Street Stocks
For the damage model, improved the durability of the engine and fluid compartments, raised the break limits for the nose, and lowered the break limits for the rear and trunk.
Fixed a misalignment with the front nose camera view.
iRacing setups have been updated.

Acura ARX-06 GTP
For Garage adjustments, a maximum front heave spring displacement of 25 mm has been imposed.

Aston Martin DBR9 GT1
For the damage model, scrape damage on the rear panels has been tuned.

Aston Martin Vantage GT4
Fixed an issue with the rear bumper appearing to dislocate at certain camera distances.
Fixed an issue where wet tires could appear unrealistically dark.
The headlight switch now appears active when in rainy weather.

Audi R18
Fixed a display issue with the tires in UI renders.

BMW M4 GT4
Fixed an issue where rain aerospray was appearing inside the cockpit in mirrors.
Fixed a flickering issue with the rear windshield in the Paint Shop.

Chevrolet Corvette Z06 GT3.R
Fixed an issue where the Fuel per Lap display had an incorrect number of digits.
Fixed an issue where the IMSA digits were always showing red instead of allowing green for GTD.
Fixed an issue where the taillights could disappear at certain camera distances.
The rearview camera screen is now present when viewing this car from outside the cockpit.
Fixed an issue where opponent vehicles were always displaying an active ABS warning light.
Fixed an issue where the fuel cap was missing in UI renders.
iRacing setups have been updated.

Dirt Sprint Car
Fixed an issue where the RPM digits were not rendering correctly.

Dirt Sprint Car Non-Winged
Fixed an issue where the RPM digits were not rendering correctly.

Dirt Street Stock
Fixed an issue where the RPM digits were not rendering correctly.

FIA F4
iRacing setups have been updated.

Ford Mustang GT3
Fixed an issue where pit stop adjustments did not always work.
For the damage model, raised and stiffened the roof collision hull.
For the damage model, the rear wing and trunk may now be fully detached.
Fixed an issue with the digital display of the brake bias state.
Fixed an issue where pit speed overspeed bar differs between live and replay remote in Motec.
Fixed some display issues with the window banner at different camera distances.
The IMSA decal layer is now appropriately used for IMSA events.
Fixed an issue where rain aerospray was appearing inside the cockpit in mirrors.
Rotor glow texture has been updated.

Global Mazda MX-5 Cup
Fixed an issue where the Simulation would crash if only right-side tires were changed.
Fixed an issue with the windshield texture for this vehicle in UI images.

Honda Civic Type R TCR
Fixed an appearance issue with tire rims.
Missing hood latches have been added to the interface model of this car.

Ligier JS P320
The cockpit dashboard buttons now illuminate correctly when in rainy weather.

Lucas Oil Off Road Pro Trucks
(Pro 4 Truck) - Fixed an issue where wet tires could appear unrealistically dark.

McLaren 570S GT4
Fixed an issue with missing rainlights.

McLaren MP4-12C GT3
iRacing setups have been updated.

Mercedes-AMG GT4
Fixed an issue where the rain lights were not removed if the trunk was detached.
Fixed an issue where lower fidelity rain lights were not appearing for this car at long camera distances.
The headlight switch now appears active when in rainy weather.

Modified - SK / NASCAR Whelen Tour Modified
(Modified - SK) - For the damage model, the force damage that can reach the engine compartment from the rear has been reduced.

NASCAR Cup Series Toyota Camry
Fixed an art issue where the tires and rims were slightly misaligned.

Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 Clubsport MR
Fixed an issue with the windshield reflections in rain.
Fixed issues with the rear rain light and the digital display for “Wet Tire” not working correctly.

Porsche Mission R
Fixed an issue with some occasional excessive cockpit windshield glare.

SRX
iRacing setups have been updated.

[Legacy] NASCAR Cup Chevrolet Impala COT - 2009
iRacing setups have been updated.


[b]TRACKS:
[/b]--------------------------------------------------------------
Circuit of the Americas
Curbs have been updated with new shaders that allow for appropriate headlight illumination at night.

Circuito de Jerez - Ángel Nieto
Barney is now waving the checkered flag at the correct location.

Circuito de Navarra
Barney, Legendary Flagman, has arrived to ply his trade!
The gain-time checkpoint for Turn 11 has been adjusted.
(Speed Circuit - Short) - Fixed an exploit where laps could be completed by circling pit lane.
(Speed Circuit - Medium) - Removed a phantom collision box.

Nürburgring
Fixed an issue where a corner curb type was not receiving light from headlights.

Oswego Speedway
Asphalt color and roughness have been adjusted.
Poplar trees have been updated.

Sachsenring
Barney, Legendary Flagman, has entered the battlefield!
A missing office building has appeared!

Some additional parked vehicles have arrived.
Some banners have been updated.
